item.title: Anthony Kazmierczak faces federal charges in Ilhan Omar town hall attack
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS >> A federal criminal complaint that was made public today accused Anthony Kazmierczak of assaulting Rep. Ilhan Omar, D-Minn., at a town hall this week in Minneapolis. Kazmierczak used a syringe to spray Omar with apple cider vinegar and water, an FBI agent wrote in court documents.

item.title: Musk’s SpaceX and xAI in merger talks ahead of planned IPO
item.description: NEW YORK >> Elon Musk’s SpaceX and xAI are in discussions to merge ahead of a blockbuster public offering planned for later this year. The combination would bring Musk’s rockets, Starlink satellites, the X social media platform and Grok AI chatbot under one roof, according to a person briefed on the matter and two recent company filings seen by Reuters.

item.title: Schofield Barracks woman pleads not guilty in boiling liquid assault
Search continues for 19-year-old man swept out to sea on Kauai
item.description: A multi-agency search continues today for a missing man swept out to sea on Wednesday at Kahili Beach in Kilauea.

item.title: Ex-deputy sentenced to 20 years in fatal shooting of Sonya Massey
item.description: The Illinois sheriff’s deputy who shot and killed Sonya Massey, a Black woman who was confronted by officers at her home in 2024 after she had called 911, has been sentenced to 20 years in prison.

item.title: Shark warning signs posted at Pokai Bay
item.description: Shark warning signs have been posted at Pokai Bay on Oahu’s West side this morning after an aggressive, 7-foot shark was spotted about 300 yards off shore.

item.title: Woman, 40s, in serious condition after solo crash in Waimanalo
item.description: A woman in her 40s is in serious condition after a solo crash in Waimanalo overnight, according to first responders.

item.title: Hawaii island police say man died after solo crash in Hilo
item.description: Hawaii island police say a man died following a solo car crash just after midnight in Hilo today.

item.title: Costco sued over preservatives in its $5 rotisserie chickens
item.description: Two women in Southern California said in a lawsuit that Costco used false advertising by labeling its rotisserie chicken as preservative-free.

item.title: Rainbows rally on road, only to fall in OT vs. Irvine
item.description: The Hawaii men’s basketball team ran out of fantastic finishes in an 87-76 overtime loss to UC Irvine tonight in the Bren Events Center in Orange County, Calif.
